children: KITE tokens affected by the Binance security incident are frozen. The Kite team is working with Binance and industry partners to trace the affected funds and recover them.

The freeze removes the stolen tokens from circulation while recovery efforts continue. Binance has also committed to covering the stolen assets and buying back the impacted tokens. These commitments support the KITE float, the supply of tokens available for trading.
